snippet.title: Ek Durood, Das Rehmatein! | Sahih Muslim 408 | Shab-e-Jumu'ah Ka Amal #shorts
snippet.description:
Ek lamha, aur das rehmatein. Aaj raat Shab-e-Jumu'ah hai.

Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا»
"Jo mujh par ek baar durood bheje, Allah us par das baar rehmat farmata hai."

Reference
• Sahih Muslim 408: https://sunnah.com/muslim:408

Aaj raat, kam az kam das baar durood parhein: Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
